messages:
Jordan W: Heads-up — opening a small TF change to add a secondary NAT per-AZ for egress redundancy (az-1 + az-2). Plan passes locally. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123

Samir: quick q — are we creating new public subnets for the nat shards or reusing existing egress subnets?

Jordan W: reusing edge-egress-* subnets, but we'll tag them nat-secondary and add a route table associating to the new NAT ENIs. Terraform snippet:

```hcl
resource "aws_nat_gateway" "secondary" {
  allocation_id = aws_eip.secondary.id
  subnet_id     = aws_subnet.edge_egress_1.id
  tags = { Name = "nat-secondary-${var.az}" }
}
```

Rachel K: main concern is route propagation to TGW attachments — can we avoid overlap with existing static routes? Also remember to update the subnet cidr_filter in the shared-services role.

Samir: cost note: two additional NAT gateways ~ $90/mo each + EIPs. ok for P0?

Jordan W: we've scoped to critical workloads only (internal training jobs + third-party webhooks). I can gate by a feature flag + canary 10% of traffic.

infra-bot: tf plan summary: 4 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy. Plan approved by auto-linter.

Rachel K: left one inline comment on the PR about using aws_nat_gateway instead of a NAT instance. Also please add a short rollback playbook in the PR description (how to remove NAT, reassign routes).

Samir: LGTM after you address the route-table association line. Also add note to run `terraform state rm` steps in rollback because we sometimes need to detach before delete.

Jordan W: cool — I'll address comments, push a new commit, and kick off a staged apply in prod-canary-ns next Wednesday 06:00 UTC. Thanks.

infra-bot: apply queued by @jordan_w to workspace prod-canary-ns at 2026-03-25T06:00:00Z
